issue_context.title: Incorrect order of arguments when calling the `XmlConfigurationElementTextContent` constructor
comments:
Tagging subscribers to this area: @dotnet/area-extensions-configuration See info in [area-owners.md](https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/main/docs/area-owners.md) if you want to be subscribed.
Issue Details
I found 2 suspicious code fragments with possible incorrect order of arguments. The `XmlConfigurationElementTextContent` constructor signature: ```csharp public XmlConfigurationElementTextContent(string textContent, int? linePosition, int? lineNumber) ``` [Link to the sources](https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/v7.0.0/src/libraries/Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration.Xml/src/XmlConfigurationElementTextContent.cs) The second argument is `linePosition` and the third is `lineNumber`. It looks like in both cases below the `lineNumber` and the `linePosition` arguments are mixed up. **Suspicious call №1** ```csharp if (preNodeType == XmlNodeType.Element) { var lineInfo = reader as IXmlLineInfo; var lineNumber = lineInfo?.LineNumber; var linePosition = lineInfo?.LinePosition; parent.TextContent = new XmlConfigurationElementTextContent(string.Empty, lineNumber, linePosition); } ``` [Link to the sources](https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/d099f075e45d2aa6007a22b71b45a08758559f80/src/libraries/Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration.Xml/src/XmlStreamConfigurationProvider.cs#L133) **Suspicious call №2** ```csharp if (currentPath.Count != 0) { var lineInfo = reader as IXmlLineInfo; var lineNumber = lineInfo?.LineNumber; var linePosition = lineInfo?.LinePosition; XmlConfigurationElement parent = currentPath.Peek(); parent.TextContent = new XmlConfigurationElementTextContent(reader.Value, lineNumber, linePosition); } ``` [Link to the sources](https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/d099f075e45d2aa6007a22b71b45a08758559f80/src/libraries/Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration.Xml/src/XmlStreamConfigurationProvider.cs#L148)
Author: VasilievSerg
